card.title: TYPE 94 TK EARLY
card.text: Gets +1 attack when it damages the enemy HQ.
card.flavorText: The Type 94 tankette, also known as TK (short for Tokushu Keninsha, meaning "special tractor"), was a small armored vehicle used by the Imperial Japanese Army in various conflicts, including the Second Sino-Japanese War, the Battles of Khalkhin Gol against the Soviet Union, and World War II. Although tankettes were commonly used for tasks such as transporting ammunition and providing support to infantry, they were primarily designed for reconnaissance rather than direct combat. The lightweight Type 94 tankette demonstrated its effectiveness in China, where the Chinese National Revolutionary Army had limited resources and only three tank battalions at their disposal. These battalions were equipped with a few British export models and Italian CV-33 tankettes. It's worth noting that, like most tankettes built in the 1920s and 1930s, the Type 94 had thin armor, making it very vulnerable to both artillery and machine gun fire.
